summary: PR 1527 enforces an fp32 returned tensor and its regression passes, while the prepared base already contains the GLM-5.2 correction-bias fix. However, the actual untuned aiter fallback computes a bf16 F.linear result and only then casts it to fp32, leaving the reported precision problem intact and undetected by the dtype-only regression.

tests.what_was_measured: At the recorded base, the real imported aiter router helper returned torch.bfloat16 for (8,7168,256), (65,512,64), and (1,7168,256), with finite outputs and nonzero error versus independent fp32 torch linear references.
At exact candidate 034ffd7a3995b4cd941f38ee5398250be938b599, the candidate dtype/shape/finiteness regression passed for its production and fallback shapes (1 test, 2 subtests).
Nine pre-existing tests passed for GLM-5.2 fp32 correction-bias allocation, collapse behavior, and architecture boundaries.

Before a later unrelated stale-argument error, four real candidate GEMMs returned fp32 values that were all exactly bf16-representable. The production and three other shapes matched or nearly matched an fp32 reference rounded through bf16, demonstrating cast-after-rounding behavior.

A close-score case collapsed all eight fp32 biases to 34.0 in bf16 and changed selected experts from [7,6] to [0,1]; the actual aiter route selected [7,6], confirming the base's pre-existing correction-bias fix.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, HIP 7.2.26015. Raw logs are retained under reports/j-355f1205be42/raw/.

remaining_counterexamples: For the untuned production shape (8,7168,256), candidate output is fp32 by dtype but exactly equals fp32-reference.to(bfloat16).float(), so no extra logit precision is retained.
For all four independently tested shapes, every candidate output value is exactly representable in bf16 because aiter torch_gemm ignores otype and tgemm.mm casts only after F.linear returns.
The candidate regression asserts dtype, shape, and finiteness only and therefore passes when bf16 results are merely widened to fp32.
remaining_limitations: No GLM-5.2 weights were available, so full-model semantic and accuracy behavior was not tested.
Only one assigned gfx950 GPU was used; multi-GPU and multi-node behavior was not tested.
The installed aiter dispatcher had no tuned entry for the tested shapes; tuned kernels remain unverified.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
